name: Christina Serum
original_name: クリスティーナ・セラム
source:
"If things ever get tough, you can talk to me, okay? HEY!"

A girl who appears to be generous, but can flip a switch when crossed. Christina is known for her inferiority complex, which she sometimes takes out on [url=/c94036]Paula[/url] despite her being one of the only people she can talk to.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request-2/chara/?page=christina]official page[/url]]
